arxiv-1904-10079.title: NeurIPS 2019 Competition: The MineRL Competition on Sample Efficient Reinforcement Learning using Human Priors
arxiv-1904-10079.creator: William H. Guss, Cayden Codel, Katja Hofmann, Brandon Houghton, Noboru Kuno, Stephanie Milani, Sharada Mohanty, Diego Perez Liebana, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Nicholay Topin, Manuela Veloso, Phillip Wang
arxiv-1904-10079.description: Abstract Competition Overview Though deep reinforcement learning has led to breakthroughs in many difficult domains, these successes have required an ever-increasing number of samples. As state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) systems require an exponentially increasing number of samples, their development is restricted to a continually shrinking segment of the AI community.

arxiv-2109-14145.title: Reciprocity in the Langlands program since Fermat’s Last Theorem Thanks: The author was supported in part by NSF Grant DMS-2001097
arxiv-2109-14145.creator: Frank Calegari
arxiv-2109-14145.description: Abstract . The reciprocity conjecture in the Langlands program links motives to automorphic forms. The proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem by Wiles [ 180 , 169 ] introduced new tools to study reciprocity. This survey reports on developments using these ideas (and their generalizations) in the last three decades. 1.

arxiv-2207-00277.title: A non-uniform extension of Baranyai’s Theorem
arxiv-2207-00277.creator: Jinye He, Hao Huang, Jie Ma
arxiv-2207-00277.description: Abstract A celebrated theorem of Baranyai states that when k k divides n n , the family K n k K_{n}^{k} of all k k -subsets of an n n -element set can be partitioned into perfect matchings. In other words, K n k K_{n}^{k} is 1 1 -factorable.

arxiv-2211-01918.title: A Dynamic Observer for a Class of Infinite-Dimensional Vibrating Flexible Structures
arxiv-2211-01918.creator: Alexander Zuyev, Julia Kalosha
arxiv-2211-01918.description: Abstract Infinite-dimensional control systems with outputs are considered in the Hamiltonian formulation with generalized coordinates. An explicit scheme for constructing a dynamic observer for this class of systems is proposed with arbitrary gain coefficients. Sufficient conditions for the convergence of the constructed observer are obtained on the basis of the invariance principle.

arxiv-2312-13313.title: ParamISP: Learned Forward and Inverse ISPs using Camera Parameters —– Supplementary Material —–
arxiv-2312-13313.creator: Woohyeok Kim Geonu Kim Junyong Lee, [1mm] Seungyong Lee Seung-Hwan Baek Sunghyun Cho, [2mm] POSTECH Samsung AI Center Toronto
arxiv-2312-13313.description: Abstract Figure S1 : Qualitative results of deblurring dataset synthesis. Compared to other methods, the deblurring model Chen et al. 2022 trained on the dataset synthesized by our ISP models more effectively restores sharp details. † † ∗ Equal contribution. † † † Work done prior to joining Samsung.

arxiv-2403-03340.title: Relating the Hall conductivity to the many-body Chern number using Fermi’s Golden rule and Kramers-Kronig relations
arxiv-2403-03340.creator: Nathan Goldman, Tomoki Ozawa
arxiv-2403-03340.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nathan Goldman, Tomoki Ozawa. This pedagogical piece provides a surprisingly simple demonstration that the quantized Hall conductivity of correlated insulators is given by the many-body Chern number, a topological invariant defined in the space of twisted boundary conditions. In contrast to conventional proofs, generally based on the Kubo formula, our approach entirely relies on combining Kramers-Kronig relations and Fermi’s golden rule within a circular-dichroism framework.

arxiv-2403-10313.title: Interactive Trimming against Evasive Online Data Manipulation Attacks: A Game-Theoretic Approach
arxiv-2403-10313.creator: Yue Fu, Qingqing Ye, Rong Du, Haibo Hu
arxiv-2403-10313.description: Abstract With the exponential growth of data and its crucial impact on our lives and decision-making, the integrity of data has become a significant concern. Malicious data poisoning attacks, where false values are injected into the data, can disrupt machine learning processes and lead to severe consequences.

arxiv-2407-07551.title: Arabic Automatic Story Generation with Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-07551.creator: Ahmed Oumar El-Shangiti Fakhraddin Alwajih, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
arxiv-2407-07551.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a powerful tool for a wide range of language generation tasks. Nevertheless, this progress has been slower in Arabic. In this work, we focus on the task of generating stories from LLMs. For our training, we use stories acquired through machine translation (MT) as well as GPT-4.

arxiv-2504-12605.title: AdaQual-Diff: Diffusion-Based Image Restoration via Adaptive Quality Prompting
arxiv-2504-12605.creator: Xin Su, Chen Wu, Yu Zhang, Chen Lyu, Zhuoran Zheng ✉
arxiv-2504-12605.description: Abstract . Restoring images afflicted by complex real-world degradations remains challenging, as conventional methods often fail to adapt to the unique mixture and severity of artifacts present. This stems from a reliance on indirect cues which poorly capture the true perceptual quality deficit.

arxiv-2507-03327.title: Read Quietly, Think Aloud: Decoupling Comprehension and Reasoning in LLMs
arxiv-2507-03327.creator: Yuanxin Wang, & Ganesh Venkatesh
arxiv-2507-03327.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in understanding text and generating high-quality responses. However, a critical distinction from human cognition is their typical lack of a distinct internal ‘reading’ or deliberation phase before ‘speaking’ (i.e., generating text). Humans often engage in silent reading to comprehend context and formulate thoughts prior to articulation.

arxiv-2507-10882.title: Orders of commutators and Products of conjugacy classes in finite groups
arxiv-2507-10882.creator: Hung P. Tong-Viet
arxiv-2507-10882.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hung P. Tong-Viet. Let G G be a finite group, let x ∈ G x\in G and let p p be a prime. We prove that the commutator [ x , g ] [x,g] is a p p -element for every g ∈ G g\in G if and only if x x is central modulo O p ​ ( G ) , O_{p}(G), where O p ​ ( G ) O_{p}(G) denotes the largest normal p p -subgroup of G G .

arxiv-2509-22566.title: From Parameters to Behaviors: Unsupervised Compression of the Policy Space
arxiv-2509-22566.creator: Davide Tenedini, Riccardo Zamboni, Mirco Mutti, Marcello Restelli
arxiv-2509-22566.description: Abstract Despite its recent successes, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is notoriously sample-inefficient. We argue that this inefficiency stems from the standard practice of optimizing policies directly in the high-dimensional and highly redundant parameter space Θ \Theta . This challenge is greatly compounded in multi-task settings.

arxiv-2601-19062.title: Who’s in Charge? Disempowerment Patterns in Real-World LLM Usage
arxiv-2601-19062.creator: Mrinank Sharma, Miles McCain, Raymond Douglas, David Duvenaud
arxiv-2601-19062.description: Abstract Although AI assistants are now deeply embedded in society, there has been limited empirical study of how their usage affects human empowerment. We present the first large-scale empirical analysis of disempowerment patterns in real-world AI assistant interactions, analyzing 1.5 million consumer Claude.ai conversations using a privacy-preserving approach.

marlowe-doctor-faustus-1604.description: Faustus sells his soul for twenty-four years of power — the defining Renaissance tragedy of overreaching intellect.

pmc-10597763.title: Distribution of non-ceruloplasmin-bound copper after i.v. 64Cu injection studied with PET/CT in patients with Wilson disease
pmc-10597763.creator: Ditte Emilie Munk, Mikkel Holm Vendelbo, Frederik Teicher Kirk, Karina Stubkjær Rewitz, Dirk Andreas Bender, Karina Højrup Vase, Ole Lajord Munk, Hendrik Vilstrup, Peter Ott, Thomas Damgaard Sandahl
pmc-10597763.description: Background & AimsIn Wilson disease (WD), copper accumulation and increased non-ceruloplasmin-bound copper in plasma lead to liver and brain pathology. To better understand the fate of non-ceruloplasmin-bound copper, we used PET/CT to examine the whole-body distribution of intravenously injected 64-copper (64Cu).

pmc-11477396.title: Synthesis, Structure, and Actual Applications of Double Metal Cyanide Catalysts
pmc-11477396.creator: Ilya E. Nifant’ev, Pavel V. Ivchenko
pmc-11477396.description: Double metal cyanide (DMC) complexes represent a unique family of materials with an open framework structure. The main current application of these complexes in chemical industry is their use as catalysts (DMCCs) of the ring-opening polymerization of propylene oxide (PO), yielding branched polyols, highly demanded in production of polyurethanes and surfactants.

pmc-11675976.title: Some Open Questions About the Anisotropic Random Walks
pmc-11675976.creator: Endre Csáki, Antónia Földes, Daniel Campos
pmc-11675976.description: Between 2007 and 2018, we collaborated extensively with Pál Révész and Miklós Csörgő on many of the problems discussed in this paper. Over the past six years, we have continued to explore these issues, and here, we present some of the most intriguing open questions in these areas.

pmc-11713225.title: Lexicon of Dementia: A cross‐linguistic study of the impact of dementia terminology on cultural perceptions
pmc-11713225.creator: Mary Chi Michael
pmc-11713225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLanguage serves as a powerful tool in shaping perceptions and reinforcing societal norms. Current understanding suggests that the language used to describe dementia can impact how the condition is perceived, understood, and addressed within various cultural contexts. Further, language can play a pivot role in shaping caregiving practices, willingness to seek medical care, and the openness, or lack thereof, to speak about the condition.

pmc-11727446.title: Interplay of Oxidative Stress, Gut Microbiota, and Nicotine in Metabolic-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD)
pmc-11727446.creator: Irene Mignini, Linda Galasso, Giulia Piccirilli, Valentin Calvez, Fabrizio Termite, Giorgio Esposto, Raffaele Borriello, Luca Miele, Maria Elena Ainora, Antonio Gasbarrini, Maria Assunta Zocco, Sunmin Park
pmc-11727446.description: Oxidative stress has been described as one of the main drivers of intracellular damage and metabolic disorders leading to metabolic syndrome, a major health problem worldwide. In particular, free radicals alter lipid metabolism and promote lipid accumulation in the liver, existing in the hepatic facet of metabolic syndrome, the metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD).

pmc-12487033.creator: Emanuele Serafin, Andrea Franceschini, Francesco Ditonno, Endri Toska, Alberto Baielli, Antonio Raiti, Damiano D’Aietti, Francesca Montanaro, Luca Rahmati, Mattia Ronca, Peres Fokana Pongmoni, Sonia Costantino, Vincenzo Vetro, Alessandro Veccia, Riccardo Rizzetto, Alberto Bianchi, Alessandra Gozzo,

Patients, stone characteristics – including Guy’s stone (GSS) and S.T.O.N.E.

pmc-12524972.title: Pancreatitis
pmc-12524972.creator: Alaa Abd‐Elsayed, Christopher Gilligan
pmc-12524972.description: ncreatitis is being managed. Options start with medication management, surgery, and interventional pain procedures. Procedures may include radiofrequency ablation of the splanchnic nerves, spinal cord stimulation, and celiac plexus blocks. The authors concluded that the management of chronic pancreatitis is complex and requires a multidimensional and individualized approach.

pmc-12722554.creator: Monica Abdelnour, Christine R Lockowitz, Evan E Facer, Andrew Atkinson, Sara Malone, Virginia R McKay, Rebekah E Dumm, Alexander S Plattner, Matthew M Sattler, Jason G Newland

pmc-13258881.title: LC-HR2FNet: High-Resolution Early-Level Fusion-Based LiDAR-Camera Network for Accurate Road Segmentation Autonomous Driving
pmc-13258881.creator: Lele Wang, Ming Li, Peng Zhang
pmc-13258881.description: Accurate road segmentation is a core perceptual technology for autonomous driving, but faces two challenges: (1) ambiguous road boundaries caused by insufficient modeling of contextual information relationships in CNN-based networks and (2) inadequate LiDAR-camera fusion due to modality gaps between heterogeneous sensors.

pmc-13491516.title: Statistics of Marginal Wave Functions as a Real-Space Diagnostic of Quantum Entanglement
pmc-13491516.creator: Ivan P. Christov
pmc-13491516.description: We present a statistical framework for extracting spatially resolved entanglement directly from an ensemble of marginal (one-body) wave functions in time-dependent Quantum Monte Carlo (TDQMC). Treating the guide waves as a statistical mixture in Hilbert space, we show that the Gram matrix acts as a covariance operator whose spectrum coincides with the Schmidt spectrum.
